# laravelforge_server_ssh_key (Data Source)

Fetches a single SSH key on a Laravel Forge server by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the SSH key.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the SSH key belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Display name of the SSH key.
- `status` (String) Installation status.
- `username` (String) System user the key is installed for (e.g. `forge`).
